facts.text: Maria wanted to make connections, laugh together, and take in nature's beauty during the hike.

evidence.quote: I wanted to make connections, laugh together and take in nature's beauty. Uplifting!

facts.text: Maria felt a sense of peace after reaching the top of the hike and seeing the breathtaking view.

evidence.quote: Reaching the top was amazing - the view was breathtaking! Seeing how huge the world is made me feel like I'm part of something special - gave me a real sense of peace.

facts.text: Maria had a great experience hiking with her church friends, feeling refreshed by being surrounded by supportive people and enjoying nature.

evidence.quote: I had a great experience last weekend hiking with my church friends - it was great to be surrounded by supportive people and to enjoy nature. Felt so refreshing!
